name: Earth radiogenic heat (U + Th + K), total
derivation: Published geoneutrino/BSE totals: low KamLAND 2022 total 14.6 TW; central Huang 2013 BSE 20.1 TW; high Borexino 2020 U+Th 38.2 TW + ~4 TW K-40. See derivations.md B1
notes: Bounds span published central estimates, not a statistical 5th-95th interval. Surface heat loss 47 +- 2 TW (S0603).

name: Earth radiogenic heat from U-238 + U-235 series (BSE split at Th/U = 3.9, K/U = 14000)
derivation: P_i = f_i x B01 with f_i = h_i m_i / sum(h m); h from nuclides.csv/groups.csv chain energies; f = 0.3957. See derivations.md B1
notes: Split fractions use the Huang 2013 BSE mass ratios; KamLAND 2022 with free Th/U gives a different split.

name: K-40 in the oceans
derivation: A = V rho w_K (N_A abund / M_K) lambda; see derivations.md B2
notes: Ocean K = 5.466e+17 kg; A_K40 = 3.164e+04 Bq/kg K. Seawater density bounds are judgement.

name: K-40 in the oceans, radioactive power
derivation: P = A x Ebar(K40) = A x 0.67847 MeV; see derivations.md B2
notes: Antineutrino excluded (groups.csv).

name: Natural Rn-222 exhalation from ice-free land
derivation: Phi x A_land x t_a (UNSCEAR 0.016 Bq/m2/s; Hirao 0.0213) bracketed with Zhang 2021 inventories 1.94-2.41 GCi/a; see derivations.md B3
notes: UNSCEAR-flux total 6.694e+19; Hirao-flux total 8.911e+19; JA97/ZK11/ZKC/SW98 = 7.178e+19/7.807e+19/8.214e+19/8.917e+19. Head activity is Rn-222 only (D24).

name: Cosmogenic H-3 production
derivation: UNSCEAR 2000 Annex B Table 4: 72.0 PBq/a (x 1e15); bounds +-30 % judgement; steady-state check P = A lambda^-1 in derivations.md B4
notes: UNSCEAR gives no uncertainty; bounds are a judgement. Modern C-14 production estimates may be lower (see notes in derivations.md).

notes: Soil mass 1.989e+17 kg treats all ice-free land as soil (no bare rock, lakes, bedrock correction): an upper-side bias. Median concentration 400.0 Bq/kg (UNSCEAR 2000 Table 6).

name: Natural U-238 dissolved in the oceans
derivation: A = V rho [U] M_U x A_U238/kg; see derivations.md B7
notes: Ocean U = 4.530e+12 kg (4.53e+09 t). Head activity U-238; U-234 adds ~1.14x more (not counted). Th not included (no sourced ocean mean).

name: Natural U-238 in the top 1 km of the continental crust (ice-free land)
derivation: A = A_land x 1 km x rho x [U] x A_U238/kg; see derivations.md B8
notes: Crust mass 3.579e+20 kg; U 9.665e+14 kg. Upper-continental-crust U (2.7 ppm) applied to the full depth; bounds from +-0.6 ppm as 1 sigma.
